title: Whoop button
description: Bold uppercase buttons: a black pill CTA, a black rounded-rectangle buy button with an optional icon, and a hairline outline twin. Colours swap in 0.125s on hover.
notes: on black bands pass tone="inverse" so the fill becomes white
name: whoop-button

props.name: href
props.description: renders a link when set, a button otherwise

props.name: shape
props.description: pill: fully round CTA (48px) · block: 11px-rounded full-width buy button (52px) · outline: hairline twin of block (48px)

props.name: tone
props.description: default: black on light surfaces · inverse: white, for black bands

props.name: icon
props.description: an icon before the label (e.g. a lucide bag)
